collectedSources.view: wide three-quarter view of Guldkringlan from Torget, ~980×551. Falu-red vertical timber siding, white-framed double-hung windows in a regular rhythm across at least two visible storeys, central entrance beneath 'GULDKRINGLAN' gold-on-black sign board, concrete ramp with steel railing, small Swedish flags in the door windows, red 'STANNA' vehicle-stop sign at ramp corner, wrought-iron lantern on a low black pole to the left, bare deciduous trees, cobbled forecourt, adjacent lighter side building visible at left edge
collectedSources.notes: Confirms entrance side faces the Torget cobble apron. Roof not visible; footprint depth still not resolved. Complements guldkringlan2.jpg by adding streetscape context (lantern, forecourt, adjacent building, cobble surface).
